title: Product Sans / Numerals
slide_intent: Study numeral construction as carefully as letters because numbers must share the typeface’s character while staying distinct.
strategic_value: Related counters and terminals can make numerical content feel part of the Product Sans family.
demonstration: Oversized white 6 7 8 9 sit across the upper blue field, with a lower-left note about circular counters and extended terminals.
practical_value: Compare number counters and overshoot together rather than assuming every numeral aligns mechanically to the same bounds.

content_islands.name: Numeral row
content_islands.spec: Set 6 7 8 9 at very large scale with enough separation to inspect their forms.

content_islands.name: Construction explanation
content_islands.spec: Place the note beneath the row, describing slight optical corrections and terminal extensions.

reference_purposes.Intent: The note explains how circular counters and squared terminals maintain the typeface’s geometric character.
reference_purposes.Expression: The enlarged numerals reveal their counters and terminal shapes.
reference_purposes.Application: The caption identifies optical corrections and extensions beyond baseline or cap height.
